h: About half my listings lost their Best Offer and I didn't notice.
t: Syncs overwrote it over time, quiet as anything. No warning, no error — the button just wasn't there anymore. Best Offer is how a buyer starts a conversation. Without it, they…

h: Check your titles. The rarity word matters more than you think.
t: Buyers search by rarity. A listing that never says the rarity is invisible to the exact person hunting that card. I just ordered the fix on my own store — rarity words back where…

h: One-buck starts until I hit a thousand sales.
t: That's the plan. Volume over margin, every show, until the instant-payout milestone falls. A one-buck start isn't giving cards away — it's letting the room decide what a card's…

h: Know what every card actually cost you.
t: I watched a full-time seller walk through his process last night — and the whole thing starts with a ledger. A thousand-buck collection, a hundred and twelve cards, about nine…

h: Today's the day the van gets finished.
t: The pans went on snug last night. Today they get torqued down, the transmission mount gets swapped, fluid gets topped off, and the coolant reservoir and battery tray go back in.…

h: My grading take, plain as I can say it.
t: Most cards don't need a slab. They need a sleeve. Grading is for the card that's already special — the one where the grade changes the story.
